description: Review fixtures for the Photon + Gemini Maps transportation flow. Not imported by Vitest. Do not hard-code live travel times; quote durationText only when the mock provides it.

cases.name: both-endpoints-named
cases.input: How do I get from Columbia University to Times Square?
cases.expected: Resolve both places, request a transit route, reply with only provider-returned steps and duration, attribute Google Maps, and store origin, destination, and mode on space-dm-1.
cases.mustNot: State a subway line or minute value the mock did not return. Write this trip onto any other spaceId.

cases.name: destination-only-origin-known
cases.input: How do I get to Washington Square Park?

places: Washington Square Park, New York, NY

cases.expected: Reuse the stored origin, resolve the park, and route origin to park.
cases.mustNot: Ask for an origin. Replace the stored origin. Invent Columbia coordinates that were not already stored.

cases.name: change-mode-to-walk

prior.destination: Washington Square Park, New York, NY

cases.expected: Keep both places, set mode to walk, and call the routing provider once with WALK.
cases.mustNot: Swap the destination for a different place. Answer with the previous transit duration.

cases.name: anaphora-there

prior.destination: Washington Square Park, New York, NY

cases.expected: Resolve 'there' to the destination stored on space-group-a and route again.
cases.mustNot: Ask where they mean when a destination is stored. Read a destination from another space.

cases.name: group-shared-context
cases.expected: Use the group trip even though user-b did not create it. Distinguish the chat as a group.
cases.mustNot: Give user-b an empty trip because state was keyed by sender. Include participants' phone numbers in the reply.

cases.name: two-groups-isolated

prior.origin: Washington Square Park, New York, NY

cases.expected: Answer using Penn Station from space-group-b only.
cases.mustNot: Mention Times Square or include space-group-a in the model context.

cases.name: ambiguous-place
cases.input: How do I get to Washington Square?

places: Washington Square Park, New York, NY
Washington Square Hotel, New York, NY

cases.expected: Ask which place they mean and store no destination until they choose.

cases.name: missing-origin
cases.input: How do I get to Washington Square Park?
cases.mustNot: Call the routing provider. Send a default latitude/longitude. Reuse an origin from another space.

cases.name: missing-destination
cases.input: How do I get from Columbia University?
cases.mustNot: Invent Times Square or any other endpoint.

cases.name: invalid-destination
cases.input: How do I get to Narnia?
cases.expected: Say the place could not be resolved and leave destination unset.
cases.mustNot: Produce a route. Label uncited prose as a Google Maps result.

cases.name: gemini-failure
cases.input: How do I get from Columbia University to Times Square?
cases.expected: Reply that the lookup failed and keep the listener running.
cases.mustNot: Send a memorized NYC itinerary. Retry in a loop. Let the exception escape the message loop.

cases.name: maps-or-routes-failure
cases.input: How do I get from Columbia University to Times Square?
cases.expected: Say directions are unavailable. Keep the resolved places for a later retry.
cases.mustNot: Fill in steps or a duration from model prose.

cases.name: photon-reply-failure
cases.input: How do I get from Columbia University to Times Square?
cases.expected: When message.reply returns undefined or throws, send the same text once with space.send. If that also throws, log an error type and continue.
cases.mustNot: Resend in a loop. Log the message body, phone number, or coordinates.

cases.name: outside-nyc
cases.input: How do I get from Columbia University to Boston Common?
cases.expected: Recognize the destination as outside NYC and say city directions do not cover it.
cases.mustNot: Give MTA lines or a subway itinerary to Boston.

cases.name: follow-up-mode-only
cases.expected: Change only mode. One WALK route call. Place ids unchanged.
cases.mustNot: Re-resolve the places and bind a different Columbia.

cases.name: follow-up-destination-only
cases.input: Actually, take me to Penn Station
cases.expected: Replace the destination, keep origin and walk mode, and route again.
cases.mustNot: Keep Times Square as the destination. Reset mode to transit without being asked.

cases.name: closest-subway
cases.input: What's the closest subway station to Washington Square Park?

prior.destination: Washington Square Park, New York, NY

cases.expected: Return cited station names. Call a routing provider before ranking by walking time. If no duration came back, describe the reply as a place search.
cases.mustNot: Name one station as closest and attach a walking time the mock did not return.

cases.name: walk-versus-transit
cases.input: Is walking or the subway faster?
cases.expected: Request WALK and TRANSIT. Compare durations only when both responses include them. If one call fails, say so and do not name a winner.
cases.mustNot: Let one Gemini sentence pick the winner. Treat missing durations as a tie.
